paper_title: Joint block adjustment and variational optimization for global and local radiometric normalization toward multiple remote sensing image mosaicking
paper_source: Public author-uploaded full text on ResearchGate; equation text inspected in Section 3.1, Eq. (38)--(41).
eq38_expression: CD = sum over overlapping image pairs of w_ij * DeltaH(Ihat_ij, Ihat_ji) / N_b.
eq38_overlap_weight_definition: w_ij is proportional to the area of the overlap and normalized so that the weights sum to one.
eq38_histogram_bin_count: N_b is the histogram bin count, but no numeric value or complete binning/range specification is stated in the inspected sources.
eq38_delta_h_definition: The sources call DeltaH a bin-to-bin histogram difference, but do not uniquely specify the norm or aggregation (for example L1, total variation, or another bin-to-bin distance).
eq38_output_scale: Division by N_b is explicit; no additional 1/2 factor is source-verified.
eq39_expression: GL = (1/N) * sum over images of DeltaG(I_i, Ihat_i) / N_p.
eq39_gradient_operator: The cited public implementation uses one-pixel forward differences from the current pixel to the right and down neighbors, skips the last row/column and zero right/down neighbors, then applies atan2l(gy, gx).
eq39_orientation_definition: atan2l(gy, gx), with angles in the implementation's signed atan2 range.
eq39_delta_g_definition: The cited implementation computes the mean absolute raw difference of the paired orientation values after the stencil filter.
eq39_angle_wrap_rule: No wrap correction is implemented in the cited code; the 2024/2017 paper text does not state whether shortest-arc angular distance should replace raw absolute subtraction.
eq39_denominator: The paper explicitly uses 1/N and N_p, where N is image count and N_p is the pixel count of image i.
notes: The 2024 paper's Eq. (38)--(39) text and definitions were inspected through the public full-text page.
The openly accessible ICCV 2017 paper repeats the same metric equations and definitions, but also leaves DeltaH as a bin-wise histogram difference without specifying the distance norm.
The cited repository contains a gradient-orientation diagnostic implementation, but it does not provide a verified implementation of the Eq. (38) evaluation metric.
verification_status cannot be VERIFIED because the implementation-relevant CD histogram semantics and the GL angular wrap rule are not uniquely frozen by the sources.
